title: Will this cluster run my recipe?

scenes.heading: Ready to install? Check first.
voice: The cluster has GPUs, but the recipe also has prerequisites.
Compare the cluster snapshot with the recipe requirements before trying to run the live checks.

scenes.heading: The kernel misses the minimum
voice: In this example, the observed kernel is six point one and the recipe requires at least six point eight.
Readiness stops the run before any validator Jobs start.

scenes.heading: Check the installed stack
voice: Once the prerequisite is addressed and the bundle is deployed, choose which phases to run.
Deployment checks component health, conformance tests workload capabilities, and performance compares measurements with recipe thresholds.

scenes.heading: Act on the specific result
scenes.sub: Use the report to decide what to rerun
scenes.result: Identify what to fix or rerun
voice: The validation report shows which checks passed, failed, or were skipped.
Read the individual finding, address the affected component or prerequisite, and rerun the checks relevant to that change.

payoff: Watch an illustrative kernel prerequisite fail before validator Jobs run, then read a phase-specific result after deployment.
